Looking at this problem, I need to analyze the verification failure in `HelperA.dfy`.

The lemma `Prove` needs to show that `K.Cut(s, K.Cut(t, x)) == K.Cut(s+t, x)`.

From `Ops.dfy`, I can see:
- `O.Below(t, x)` requires `x <= t` and ensures `K.Cut(t, x) == 0`
- `O.Above(t, x)` requires `t < x` and ensures `K.Cut(t, x) == x - t`

Let me trace through the cases:

**Case 1: `x <= t`**
- `K.Cut(t, x) == 0` (via `O.Below(t, x)`)
- Need to show `K.Cut(s, 0) == K.Cut(s+t, x)`
- Since `s >= 0`, we have `0 <= s`, so `K.Cut(s, 0) == 0` (via `O.Below(s, 0)`)
- Since `x <= t` and `t <= s+t` (because `s >= 0`), we have `x <= s+t`, so `K.Cut(s+t, x) == 0` (via `O.Below(s+t, x)`)
- This works!

**Case 2: `x > t`**
- `K.Cut(t, x) == x - t` (via `O.Above(t, x)`)
- Need to show `K.Cut(s, x-t) == K.Cut(s+t, x)`

This case needs to be split further:

**Case 2a: `x > t` and `x - t <= s`** (equivalently `x <= s + t`)
- `K.Cut(s, x-t) == 0` (via `O.Below(s, x-t)`)
- `K.Cut(s+t, x) == 0` (via `O.Below(s+t, x)`)
- This works!

**Case 2b: `x > t` and `x - t > s`** (equivalently `x > s + t`)
- `K.Cut(s, x-t) == (x-t) - s == x - t - s` (via `O.Above(s, x-t)`)
- `K.Cut(s+t, x) == x - (s+t) == x - s - t` (via `O.Above(s+t, x)`)
- These are equal!

The issue in the original code is that the `else` branch doesn't properly handle the subcases. Let me fix it:

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "if x <= t {\n      O.Below(t, x);\n      O.Below(s, 0);\n      O.Below(s + t, x);\n    } else {\n      O.Above(t, x);\n      if x - t <= s {\n        O.Below(s, x - t);\n        O.Below(s + t, x);\n      } else {\n        O.Above(s, x - t);\n        O.Above(s + t, x);\n      }\n    }"
}
```
